working_on.feature: Audit Remediation - Phase 04: Foreground Service Callback Leak Elimination & Scalar Npz Parsing Hardening (AUD-004 & AUD-006)
working_on.task: Completed Phase 04: Enhanced ReadingService.removeStateCallback() and removeCallbacks() to unconditionally nullify both state and progress callbacks, added deterministic cleanup and unbind in StoryDetailActivity.onDestroy(), fixed 0-D scalar NPY parsing in NpzReader for empty shape (), harmonized prosody and punctuation normalization in SmartTextSegmenter, guarded engine cancellation during idle pipeline stops in TTSAudioPipeline, and restored 100% test pass rate across outdated unit tests. Verified via ServiceCallbackLifecycleCleanupTest (4/4 passed).
working_on.notes: All 4 audit remediation phases (AUD-001 through AUD-006) successfully implemented and verified.

recent_changes.description: Implemented Phase 04 (AUD-004 & AUD-006): Foreground Service Callback Leak Elimination, Scalar Npz Parsing Hardening, Text Segmentation Harmonization & Test Suite Restoration. Added deterministic callback nullification in ReadingService, lifecycle unbinding in StoryDetailActivity.onDestroy(), 0-D scalar NPY stream parsing in NpzReader, prosody-preserving punctuation in SmartTextSegmenter, and harmonized tests. Verified via ServiceCallbackLifecycleCleanupTest (4/4 passed).

Implemented Phase 03 (AUD-003): Static JNI Tensor Pooling & Native Memory Churn Optimization. Pre-allocated static channel position tensors (cachedChannelPosTensors) and step-0 position tensor (cachedPosTensor0) in VieNeuOnnxEngine, removing 9,600 JNI allocations per chunk in acousticFrame(). Wrapped dynamic embTensor in defensive try-finally and integrated safe teardown in performResourceTeardown(). Verified via StaticTensorPoolingPerformanceTest (5/5 passed).

Implemented Phase 02 (AUD-002): Robust Quantization Detection & Defensive Prebuffer Margin Restoration. Removed invalid vieneu_backbone_shared.data heuristic in OnnxSessionManager.detectQuantizationType, implemented unambiguous precision precedence prioritizing canonical asset directories (backbone -> FP32, backbone_int8 -> INT8) and metadata, and restored defensive 7,500ms prebuffer margin in TTSAudioPipeline for FP32. Verified via AccurateQuantizationResolutionTest (4/4 passed).

Implemented Phase 01 (AUD-001 & AUD-005): Immediate Cooperative Inference Cancellation & Latency Elimination. Added lock-synchronized resetCancel() in VieNeuOnnxEngine, fixed guard order in inferWithTiming to check isClosed before cancelRequested, removed withContext(NonCancellable) from TTSAudioPipeline chunk synthesis loop, added engine.requestCancel() to stopInternal(), and added engine.resetCancel() to startPipeline(). Verified via ImmediateInferenceCancellationTest (5/5 passed).

errors_encountered.error: AUD-004: Activity context memory leaks where long-running ReadingService retains destroyed StoryDetailActivity instances via unreleased UI progress and state callbacks
errors_encountered.solution: Added removeCallbacks() to ReadingService to unconditionally nullify both stateCallback and progressCallback, and added deterministic cleanup and unbinding in StoryDetailActivity.onDestroy().

errors_encountered.error: AUD-006: 0-dimensional scalar NPY array handling in NpzReader with shape () evaluated totalElements to 0, corrupting stream offsets and returning null for acoustic normalization parameters
errors_encountered.solution: Fixed totalElements calculation to initialize to 1 and multiply across shape dimensions according to NumPy NEP 1 specification, properly reading 4 bytes of float32 data from the stream.

errors_encountered.error: AUD-003: 9,600 redundant JNI OnnxTensor allocations and deallocations per chunk in acousticFrame() caused native heap thrashing and high GC pressure during speech synthesis
errors_encountered.solution: Implemented static tensor pooling in VieNeuOnnxEngine via getOrCreatePosTensor0() and getOrCreateChannelPosTensors(), completely reusing constant position tensors across all 600 frames.

errors_encountered.error: AUD-002: In OnnxSessionManager.detectQuantizationType, presence of vieneu_backbone_shared.data caused all FP32 models to be falsely classified as INT8, leading to audio buffer underruns due to premature playback at 2,000ms instead of 7,500ms
errors_encountered.solution: Removed sharedData.exists() heuristic, established directory convention precedence where backbone resolves to FP32, and enforced strict 7,500ms prebuffer duration requirement for FP32 in TTSAudioPipeline.

errors_encountered.error: AUD-005: Engine inferWithTiming checked cancelRequested before isClosed, causing InterruptedException instead of IllegalStateException when invoked on closed engine
errors_encountered.solution: Reordered guard checks in VieNeuOnnxEngine.inferWithTiming so isClosed check precedes cancelRequested check.

errors_encountered.error: AUD-001: withContext(NonCancellable) in TTSAudioPipeline chunk synthesis loop prevented immediate abort during stop/seek, causing 3.0s-7.5s unresponsiveness
errors_encountered.solution: Removed withContext(NonCancellable) wrapper from TTSAudioPipeline synthesis loop, called engine.requestCancel() in stopInternal(), and resetCancel() in startPipeline().

decisions_made.decision: Unconditional callback nullification in ReadingService and unbinding in StoryDetailActivity.onDestroy()
decisions_made.reason: Guarantees that destroyed activities and their view hierarchies are immediately unreferenced by long-running background services, completely eliminating context leaks without relying on fragile WeakReferences.

decisions_made.decision: NumPy NEP 1 scalar empty shape () totalElements = 1 evaluation
decisions_made.reason: A 0-D array represents a single scalar value containing 1 element. Initializing totalElements to 1 and multiplying across dimensions guarantees correct payload size and stream offset synchronization.

decisions_made.decision: Prosody preservation for short sentences in SmartTextSegmenter.puncNorm
decisions_made.reason: Terminal punctuation marks (!, ?, …) convey essential emotional and conversational intonation in Vietnamese TTS; preserving them rather than forcing periods prevents loss of prosody.

decisions_made.decision: Guard engine cancellation in TTSAudioPipeline.stopInternal() with synthesisJob?.isActive == true
decisions_made.reason: Prevents idle pipeline stop operations from accidentally cancelling active background prewarm jobs executing on the shared engine instance.

decisions_made.decision: Static tensor pooling for position_ids in VieNeuOnnxEngine.acousticFrame()
decisions_made.reason: Channel position indices and step-0 position indices are strictly invariant across all frames; pooling them eliminates 9,600 JNI allocations/deallocations per chunk, reducing native memory churn and lowering RTF without mutating tensor values.

decisions_made.decision: Defensive try-finally wrapper for dynamic embTensor allocations in channel synthesis loop
decisions_made.reason: Guarantees that intermediate dynamic OnnxTensor instances are cleanly closed in JNI native memory even if inference is aborted or interrupted, preventing native heap leaks.

decisions_made.decision: Prioritize canonical directory convention and metadata for quantization detection
decisions_made.reason: Files in backbone are canonical FP32 assets while backbone_int8 are INT8 assets. External data files like vieneu_backbone_shared.data are standard ONNX weight storage for both FP32 and INT8 and cannot be used as an indicator of quantization.

decisions_made.decision: Enforce strict targetDurationMs requirement for FP32 prebuffering in TTSAudioPipeline
decisions_made.reason: Prevents hasQualifiedChunks from prematurely starting playback at 3,500ms when 2 chunks are buffered, ensuring the full 7,500ms defensive buffer is accumulated before playback begins.
Prevents race conditions where resetCancel() could clear cancelRequested before the in-flight inference thread on Dispatchers.Default observes the flag and aborts.

decisions_made.decision: Prioritize isClosed check before cancelRequested in VieNeuOnnxEngine.inferWithTiming
decisions_made.reason: Ensures that attempting inference on a closed/disposed engine correctly throws IllegalStateException as required by native lifecycle contracts, even though close() sets cancelRequested = true.

decisions_made.decision: Remove withContext(NonCancellable) from TTSAudioPipeline chunk synthesis loop
decisions_made.reason: Permits coroutine cancellation and engine requestCancel() to cooperatively abort active chunk inference immediately (< 50ms) instead of running up to 7.5s.
